name: Storage Control Core
body: Manage your storage network here. View stock, withdraw items, and assign production to all connected cosmic workbenches.
effects: Set the storage filter for the entire network.
Withdraw items manually.
Use the added Magic Storage options to trade with traders or trade ships.
Only one control core is allowed per network.

name: Storage Unit
body: Provides storage capacity for the network.
effects: Each unit provides 64 stack slots by default, using normal item stack limits.
Adjust slots from 1 to 10,000 in the mod settings.
Stored items do not rot or tick.

name: Storage Receiver
body: The network's intake point. Colonists must haul items here to put them into storage.
effects: The control core sets the filter for incoming items.
Leave space between it and the core to avoid absorbing manually withdrawn items again.

name: Cosmic Workbench
body: Combines multiple crafting jobs at one bench. Materials come directly from the network, so workers do not need to fetch them.
effects: Supports all crafting recipes, including modded recipes.
Products go into the network by default, or can be set to drop on the ground.
Optional "Unlock workbenches" mode in settings: spend bench materials to unlock recipes.

name: Auto-Restocking Shelf
body: Keeps small amounts available for frequent use by colonists or detection by other mods.
effects: Recommended for everyday supplies such as food and medicine.
Can directly replace a nutrient paste dispenser hopper.
Set items individually, or use filter mode to choose a category of items.
A high-stack version is also available.

name: Construction Supply Unit
body: Delivers building materials directly to construction blueprints.
effects: Automatically supplies materials to building blueprints within range.
Adjust the supply range in the mod settings.
Colonists still do the construction work.

name: Apparel Adapter
body: Colonists choose suitable apparel from storage and come here to collect it, following their apparel policies.
effects: Follows vanilla apparel settings.
Serves one colonist at a time.

name: Material Supplier
body: A directional terminal that feeds network stock into the transporter or fuel device directly ahead.
effects: Use this building to load shuttles and transport pods.
Continuous mode sends up to three item types in priority order, with no internal storage.
Transport loading takes priority when a target also uses fuel.

name: Fuel Supplier
body: Automatically supplies fuel to nearby buildings.
effects: Automatically supplies fuel within 20 cells.

name: Caravan Teleporter
body: Send a prepared caravan on its way immediately.
effects: Choose people, animals, items, and travel supplies in the caravan formation menu.
On confirmation, supplies enter the members' inventories and the caravan appears on the world map.

name: Nivarian Mass Driver Extractor
body: Nivarian integration. Connects Magic Storage to the Nivarian mass driver logistics network.
effects: Delivers items requested by logistics orders directly to the adjacent mass driver.
Requires power, an active storage network, and an adjacent mass driver. Diagonal placement is allowed.

name: Cosmic Mech Gestator
body: Gestates mechs using materials directly from the storage network, with no hauling. Each gestator has its own bills.
effects: Requires no electricity. Pauses when the storage network is unavailable.
Supports standard mech gestation recipes, with the relevant research completed.
Mechanitor work, bandwidth, gestation cycles, and toxic waste follow normal rules.
